summary.en: Asset Store packages downloaded through the Unity editor. Kept forever, even for assets you no longer import.
summary.nb: Asset Store-pakker lastet ned gjennom Unity-editoren. Beholdes for alltid, også for assets du ikke lenger importerer.

note.en: Assets re-download from My Assets in the Package Manager when needed.
note.nb: Assets lastes ned på nytt fra My Assets i Package Manager ved behov.
